name: Password reset token without expiry
description:
The password reset token is a self-contained JWT with no exp claim. Unless the server tracks and expires it separately, it stays valid indefinitely, so a token leaked at any later time still resets the password.

burpsy cannot see server-side expiry without waiting real time, so this row is reported as tentative.

This row is burpsy's own: Burp's issue catalogue has no password-reset rows.
remediation: Give reset tokens a short lifetime (minutes, not days) and enforce it server-side; for a JWT, set and verify exp.

references.title: OWASP WSTG: Testing for Weak Password Change or Reset Functionalities (WSTG-ATHN-09)

vulnerabilityClassifications.title: CWE-640: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password
